metrics.label: developers bookmarked the source
metrics.caveat: A star is a bookmark by someone with a GitHub account — not a reader, and not an outcome.

metrics.label: copies taken to reuse or adapt
metrics.caveat: A fork is a copy of the code, not evidence it was used.

metrics.label: watching the repository for changes
metrics.caveat: Watchers, not stars — subscribers_count, because GitHub's watchers_count is a misnamed alias of the star count.

metrics.label: days the public web archive holds a copy
metrics.caveat: A snapshot is the Internet Archive's robot capturing the page, not a person visiting it. Captures are irregular.

metrics.label: days the record trails real time
metrics.caveat: ERA5's publication lag — a property of the data, not a limitation we chose.

metrics.label: the record was last rebuilt
metrics.caveat: When the nightly Action last ran. It says nothing about who saw the result.

metrics.label: revisions to the public source
metrics.caveat: Our activity on the code, not its effect on anyone.
